item.invasion.rift_flux.desc: Energy leaking from the rift. Dropped by invaders and generated by a Nexus.
item.invasion.small_rift.desc: A tiny, contained tear in reality. Used to arm Rift Traps.
item.invasion.catalyst_mixture.desc: Smelt to make a Nexus Catalyst.
item.invasion.nexus_catalyst.desc: Insert into a Nexus to start an invasion in wave mode (wave 1).
item.invasion.strong_catalyst_mixture.de: Smelt to make a Strong Catalyst.
item.invasion.strong_catalyst.desc: Insert into a Nexus to start an invasion in wave mode at wave 10.
item.invasion.stable_catalyst_mixture.de: Smelt to make a Stable Energy Field.
item.invasion.stable_energy_field.desc: Insert into a Nexus to start continuous mode: periodic attacks while the Nexus generates Rift Flux.
item.invasion.damping_agent.desc: Insert into an active Nexus to lower the next wave by one.
item.invasion.strong_damping_agent.desc: Insert into an active Nexus to safely end the invasion.
item.invasion.nexus_adjuster.desc: Use on an inactive Nexus to change its spawn radius (sneak to decrease).
item.invasion.probe.desc: Use on a block to see whether invaders can dig through it, or on a Nexus to see its status.
item.invasion.infused_sword.desc: Charges with every hit. When fully charged, use it to heal yourself.
item.invasion.searing_bow.desc: Fires burning arrows that hit harder.
message.invasion.start.wave: The Nexus has been activated! The first wave arrives in %s seconds.
message.invasion.start.continuous: The Nexus is now in continuous mode. The first attack arrives in %s seconds.
message.invasion.wave_start: Wave %s has begun! %s invaders are coming.
message.invasion.destroyed: The Nexus has been destroyed! You survived %s waves.
message.invasion.peaceful: The Nexus cannot be activated on Peaceful difficulty.
message.invasion.adjuster.active: The spawn radius cannot be changed during an invasion.
message.invasion.probe.diggable: %s: invaders dig through this in about %s s
